identityDecision: Commerce Logic, LLC was the manager-level Fund III add-on retained after CVO's 2022 divestiture. Tollogic is its product; CVO is the former parent; Fleetworthy and Bestpass are the acquirer and integration platform, not duplicate Commerce Logic PortCos.

ownershipDecision.rationale: Astatine confirms the retained Fund III interest; Fleetworthy's later acquisition of Commerce Logic's operating assets and integration into Bestpass ended the relevant manager-level operating-company ownership.

operatingDecision.business: Predictive tolling, GPS and telematics analytics, automated reconciliation, discrepancy detection and route optimization for commercial fleets.
operatingDecision.boundary: Do not create separate PortCos for CVO, Tollogic, Fleetworthy or Bestpass.

listDecision.rationale: The census sought companies currently owned by Astatine. Commerce Logic was acquired and integrated by Fleetworthy on 2025-07-15, so the stale manager-page status does not support a current Astatine holding.
listDecision.historicalRecordPolicy: Retain the immutable census holding, prior failed attempt and this exclusion lineage. Do not create a production or seed PortCo, active owner, pending transaction or redirect.

acquisitionAndExitCheck.historicalEntry: Astatine's page confirms Fund III retained Commerce Logic as a CVO add-on after 2022; exact original entry date, vehicle and stake are not publicly disclosed.
acquisitionAndExitCheck.exit: Fleetworthy announced the Commerce Logic asset acquisition on 2025-07-15 and integrated the technology with Bestpass.
acquisitionAndExitCheck.laterSearch: No later Astatine reacquisition, continuing manager ownership or signed pending transaction was identified through 2026-08-18.

disclosureLimits: The original Fund III add-on date, legal holding vehicle and ownership percentage are not publicly disclosed.
Fleetworthy disclosed an asset acquisition rather than a surviving Commerce Logic equity capitalization.
